outputs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a HIGH-QUALITY STUD-STYLE ROBLOX Inventory UI for Ball VS Space, following the user's supplied stud UI reference closely for its material language. This is a new visual revision, not a coding task. Single complete desktop screen, front-on orthographic UI, landscape 1536x1024, all text sharp and readable.

INPUTS:
Image 1: USER'S PRIMARY STYLE REFERENCE, a gold/brown "Gears!" Roblox UI. Study and reproduce the DESIGN LANGUAGE: dense regular grid of small raised square studs, fine upper-left highlights and lower-right shadows, narrow beveled plate edges, near-black outlines plus fine lighter inner edges, inset dark item wells with restrained radial backgrounds, bold rounded white text with a black stroke, simple tactile red close button. Do not copy its gear products, prices, stocks, rarities, title or creator signature.
Image 2: previous Inventory concept; use only its existing CONTENT and basic grid-plus-detail layout. Its smooth large blue dashboard surfaces must become more crafted stud-textured game plates.
Image 3: original ball atlas; preserve the named balls and simple sprite identities.
Image 4: original icon atlas; source for axe, category symbols and inventory cube.

ART DIRECTION:
A premium, carefully finished Roblox stud menu. Sapphire/cobalt BLUE molded studded header and frame, deep ink-navy inset interior, golden-yellow active Balls tab, saturated turquoise primary action, coral-red close button. A tactile toy-block construction with crisp micro-bevels and thin dark separators, clearly visible square STUD TEXTURE, not bolts or circles. Studs should be subtle 8–12px raised squares with uniform 24px grid spacing, consistent single-direction light, repeated straight rows across broad panel surfaces. Make the studs an important obvious material feature while keeping all labels on calm readable areas. No massive LEGO blocks, word LEGO, game-brand logo, hardware screws, weathered metal, neon glow, sci-fi framing, glass or glossy mobile dashboard. Small 5–8px corner radii, mostly rectangular. Use the reference's refined black outline / light inner bevel rather than thick clumsy cartoon stacking. Dim blurred existing blue Roblox lobby around the edges. Everything is 2D screen UI, not a perspective view of a physical board.

COMPOSITION:
Window fills about 91% of the frame with even margins, generous internal padding and disciplined alignment. A compact studded blue header: a modest original inventory cube icon and bold white "Inventory" at left, smaller "12 ball appearances" under it; square beveled red X at upper right. Title readable but not excessively huge.
Four studded category buttons in one compact row: "Balls", "Explosions", "Flyers", "Fusion". Small colorful existing icons. Balls gold-yellow, others blue/navy; white outlined labels, subtle top-edge highlights, dark recessed bottom edges.
Main content: left 66% a scrollable 3-column x 2-row collection grid, right 31% selected-item details, clean gap between them. Visible scrollbar implies the remaining collection.

SIX COLLECTION CARDS:
Each card is a nicely beveled dark-blue studded tile with a clean dark INSET IMAGE WELL and a substantial readable name plate. Stud texture visible around the well and on the lower plate at low contrast. Existing sprite centered with only a soft contact shadow and very subtle dark radial rays, as in the user reference. Equal dimensions and padding, names at least 24px in the image.
Row 1: "Verity Ball" yellow smile sphere; "Axe Ball" slate sphere with orange stripe and original axe attached; "Poison Spike Ball" plain lime sphere.
Row 2: "Burst Ball" orange sphere with pale plus; "Cell Ball" pale green concentric sphere; "Vampire Ball" red sphere with two white fangs.
Verity's tile has a small gold check plate reading "Equipped". Axe tile is selected with a crisp cyan edge, NOT luminous. The six other name labels must all be accurate; no invented balls, powers, ranks, ownership counters or rarity labels.

SELECTED-ITEM PANEL:
One crafted navy-blue studded plate with a large dark inset showcase. Small cyan "SELECTED" plaque, large "Axe Ball" title, large actual Axe sprite including weapon. A small quiet "Anchor kit" label.
Description exact: "Spins an axe, widening its territory."
Below a fine separator: "Equipped: Verity".
At bottom a wide tactile CYAN STUD-TEXTURED "Equip" button, white dark-outlined type, clean small bevel and dark bottom edge. Text should stay clearly readable over subtle studs.

Quality: cohesive custom game UI with excellent typography, finely controlled relief, consistent edge treatment, balanced negative space, and faithful existing artwork. Avoid excessive decoration. No extra controls, currency, purchasing, rarity, random sparkles, slogans, watermarks, fake implementation labels or design annotations. The reference informs style only; no copying its products or commerce.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a high-quality STUD-STYLE Roblox Store screen for Ball VS Space, matching the supplied stud Inventory concept exactly. Single front-facing desktop screen, landscape 1536x1024, all text crisp and legible.

INPUTS:
Image 1 is the USER'S stud-style "Gears!" reference: small embossed square studs, narrow bevels, black contours with fine bright inner edges, inset item previews, outlined white typography. Style only: do not use its products, prices, stocks, rarities, watermark or title.
Image 2 is our latest STUD INVENTORY: THIS is the exact blue/gold/cyan color system, stud scale, edge treatment, font weight, blurred lobby backdrop and window proportions to match.
Image 3 is the previous smooth STORE concept. Preserve its content and layout but convert the surfaces to the stud construction of image 2.
Image 4 is original ball art.
Image 5 is original icon art, including store machine, coin, gem, categories, balloons and parasol.

Visual style: crisp sapphire-blue studded frame and header, navy inset content, very modest rectangular corner rounding, thin crafted light inner bevels, dark outlines, consistent upper-left stud highlights and lower-right shadows. Clear grid of small raised square studs, not round LEGO pegs or screws. Keep textures quieter around body text. Colorful arcade energy without neon glow or metallic sci-fi trim. Actual original simple sprites in dark inset preview wells with subtle radial rays. No perspective on the GUI. Narrow blurred blue Roblox lobby around the frame. No logo, signature or annotations.

Layout: same roughly 92% width, 90% height centered window and header/tab measurements as image 2. Header left has modest white store icon and title "Store", subtitle "Explore the collection". Right has compact studded navy coin balance "0" and gem balance "0", then square studded coral-red X. No currency purchase plus buttons.
Tabs in one row: "Events", "Balls", "Explosions", "Flyers", with original small recognizable icons. Events active cyan; remaining three blue. Tabs and all buttons carry subtle small square stud texture.

Main content title "Collection picks"; small golden plaque "Free collection".
Four equal cards across, blue studded beveled outer tiles with dark inset image wells and readable outlined white names:
"Laser Ball" — smooth purple ball with lilac rim — cyan "View Ball".
"Ray Ball" — orange sphere with pale yellow horizontal band and pale yellow central disk — cyan "View Ball".
"Colorful Balloon" — original colored balloon cluster and red bow — quieter purple-blue "Preview".
"Blue Parasol" — original blue/cyan umbrella and shaft — quieter purple-blue "Preview".
Action buttons are integrated tactile rectangular studded plates with clean bottom edges, not enormous slabs. Four cards align perfectly, art has equal visual weight, and all item names remain readable.

Bottom feature banner: purple STUD-TEXTURED plate with modest darker diagonal bands, framed by black and thin lilac bevel. On left small "COLLECTION SPOTLIGHT", bold readable "Find your next favorite", subtext "12 ball appearances · All free". On right a compact composed trio of existing Laser, Ray and Orbit balls, no new items or effects. Clear separation of text from art; no glow particles or bundle parts. No extra action button.
Footer exact: "All ball appearances are free. No purchase needed."

Refined high-quality finish: regular stud grid, coherent bevel/shadow scale, clear type hierarchy, generous padding, straight alignment, controlled texture contrast. The result should look like a real attractive Roblox stud GUI built from image assets and native frames, not a glossy website or physical rendered board.
Never add rarity, prices, stock, purchase buttons, countdowns, loot boxes, fake stats, locked items, wings, new mechanics or new ball designs. Preserve existing view/preview behavior only.
